messages:
maria_sales: Syndicate sent an RFI + security spreadsheet. They want a 2-week Dedicated POC with HSM support and a pricing breakdown for ~50M tokens/mo. I've uploaded rfi_syndicate.pdf and syndicate_qs.xlsx. Can we triage quick wins vs blockers?

sam_se: I can own scheduling and the POC runbook. Do they want sanitized real logs or synthetic? That changes infra and SLA expectations.

maria_sales: PM prefers a redacted subset of real logs; they can provide a sample in 3-5 days.

alex_eng: Infra notes: we'll need VPC peering or customer VPN, IP allowlist, and HSM/KMS creds if they want BYOK. Provisioning after peering typically 3-5 business days. On-prem HSM in POC adds ~1 week.

nina_sec: On the security spreadsheet I can answer SOC2 and pen-test items now. I flagged 6 questions that need legal/security redlines (customer attestations needed). We can offer a data-deletion cert at POC end.

jen_finance: Pricing sketch for 50M tokens/mo:
- Hosted: est ~$0.0006/token -> ~$30k/mo
- Dedicated: baseline commit (~$25k+/mo) + infra; better unit economics but committed
- Private/on-prem: one-time license + infra + annual support
I'll produce a hosted vs dedicated two-column PDF by EOD.

sam_se: POC runbook (high level):
Week 0: NDA, sample due
Day1-3: Network + creds + HSM check
Day4-6: Provision dedicated pool, deploy model, smoke
Day7-10: Customer integration tests, throughput/latency baseline
Day11-14: Eval, handoff, decision meeting
Include SLOs to avoid scope creep.

alex_eng: For their expected traffic, enable prefix KV caching + 1.5x batching. Recommend q4f32 quantization for perf/quality. We'll provide a k6 script for basic load tests after smoke.

nina_sec: Risk: they list FedRAMP in compliance asks. We don't have FedRAMP hosted. Mitigations: Private deployment, partner-managed FedRAMP environment, or limited-scope contract clause. Mark for legal.

maria_sales: Please add short RFI answers for "deployment options" and "key management". Customer also wants a capability matrix comparing Hosted/Dedicated/Private on SLA, data isolation, onboarding time, cost.

jen_finance: I'll draft the matrix now and upload: syndicate_pricing_matrix_v1.pdf

nina_sec: I'll return redlines on the 6 flagged items by tomorrow AM.

alex_eng: I'll confirm exact infra lead times and attach the k6 test and a sample latency report after smoke tests.

deploy-bot: Deployment request queued: id 199001-POC-Syndicate; provision ETA ~3 business days.

maria_sales: Next steps: Sam share scope + invite, Jen final matrix, Nina redlines, Alex infra confirmation. I'll respond to the customer with the 2-week plan and request the redacted sample by EOW. :thumbsup:
